headline: Keep {arm:September}: both candidates increase production cost while regressing character adherence.
lede: Neither challenger improves character adherence, and both increase production replicating cost above {scoreboard.September.reply_cost_usd|usd_per_1k}. A switch would require a candidate to demonstrate higher fidelity or meaningful cost savings.

slots.text: Retain {arm:September}, which delivers the lowest production replicating cost at {scoreboard.September.reply_cost_usd|usd_per_1k} and the highest pass rate at {pass_rate.September|pct}.

{arm:1017} increases reply cost to {scoreboard.1017.reply_cost_usd|usd_per_1k} with lower adherence; {arm:qwen3.8-flash} costs {scoreboard.qwen3.8-flash.reply_cost_usd|usd_per_1k} and drops pass rate by {reading.qwen3.8-flash.change|abs|pts} points ({reading.qwen3.8-flash.interval|interval}).

Weakest margin sits on {weakest.arm} at {weakest.value|pts} points against {weakest.threshold|pts} points. Note reasoning ratio varied from {reasoning_ratio.1017|pct} on {arm:1017} to {reasoning_ratio.September|pct} on {arm:September}, and {arm:qwen3.8-flash} had two excluded harness failures.
Run an eval sweeping reasoning budget constraints directly against {arm:September} to measure whether constrained generation preserves adherence while controlling cost.

caveats.material_if: The aspect was declared on {late_criteria.aspect.set_at}; material only if evaluated aspects misrepresent deployment priorities.
The control assignment was designated on {late_criteria.control.set_at}; material only if another variant reflects baseline production.
The judge tier is undetermined with insufficient calibration; material only if comparative judge bias fails to cancel across arms.

method.text: Evaluated on {cases} distinct cases with up to {repeats} repeats per arm, yielding {scoreboard.September.usable} usable trials for {arm:September}.
A trial passes when automated execution checks clear and the judge scores persona holds character as passing.
Contrasts corrected using Holm's method across {family.family_size} tests at alpha={family.alpha}; intervals are reported at {family.level}.
Evaluations conducted by {judge.model} under an undetermined tier with insufficient calibration.
Simulator request settings were not recorded across runs; caller behavior may vary if unrecorded parameters differed.
Latency was not compared because all runs executed concurrently beside other workloads.
Input tokens, output tokens, and raw LLM call counts were not tracked by the telemetry harness.

Persona adherence drops most severely in the off lane stratum, down {strata.off_lane.1017.persona.holds_character.vs_control|abs|pts} points on {arm:1017} and {strata.off_lane.qwen3.8-flash.persona.holds_character.vs_control|abs|pts} points on {arm:qwen3.8-flash}.
